title: 解析解对比
design_basis: SDTwin thermal design 4.3 equation T3 and chapter 8 table 8; test case HT-003 of the Chinese test report
description: Three analytic cases integrated through sdtwin_sim.coupled.run_coupled as thermal-only runs with prescribed Power ports and the RK45 solver. Each case uses its own ThermalParameters assembled with assemble_thermal_parameters from the instance list below. Nodes that take no part in a case are kept out of the way with a path resistance of 1e12 K/W, zero port powers and exposed surfaces with zero absorptivity and zero emissivity. A temperature that the case holds constant is represented by a capacitance of 1e12 J/K.
specific_heat_source: HT-003 test configuration: every material portion uses 1000 J/(kg K), so a capacitance C in J/K is a mass of C/1000 kg (design 4.5 T5 first line)
temperature_range_source: HT-003 test configuration: declared range of the constant node parameters, wide enough for every temperature of the three cases
isolation_note: A path of 1e12 K/W carries at most 1e-10 W for a 100 K difference, about 3e-13 of the 300 W case power. A node of 1e12 J/K that receives 300 W changes by 3e-10 K/s, so its drift over a run stays below 1e-6 K, three orders below the 0.001 K acceptance threshold.

environment.earth_flux_disabled_reason: HT-003 analytic cases: Earth albedo and infrared are switched off so that the only environmental input is the stated direct sunlight (thermal design 9.4 teaching simplification, recorded here)
environment.source: HT-003 test configuration: fixed GCRS geometry with the satellite-to-Sun direction along +x and the identity body-to-GCRS attitude, so the radiator front normal faces the Sun with cos_incidence 1 and the back normal faces away

solver_settings_source: Thermal design chapter 8 table 8: adaptive RK45 with a dimensionless relative tolerance, a temperature absolute tolerance in K and a maximum step in s. The values are the tighter of the two settings listed for test case NI-001; output spacing 1 s on the accepted solution. environment_step_s and event_time_tol_s are required by SolverSettings; the constant environment has no eclipse boundary and a thermal-only run has no Power event.

step.label: 单节点阶跃
step.mass_source: HT-003 input: C_J = 500 J/K; the cold plate held at constant temperature is a 1e12 J/K heat sink; other nodes 1000 J/K
step.resistance_source: HT-003 input: R_JC = 0.1 K/W; SR, CR, BR and DR are 1e12 K/W isolation paths
step.optical_source: HT-003 test configuration: exposed surfaces exchange nothing with the environment in this case

load_step.label: P_load step from 0 W to 300 W

step.note: The load is zero for 100 s, then steps to 300 W; the run ends 10 time constants R_JC C_J = 50 s after the step.

series.label: 串联稳态
series.mass_source: HT-003 series case: C_J = 500 J/K as in the step case, C_C = 1000 J/K chosen for the test; the radiator held at constant temperature is a 1e12 J/K heat sink; other nodes 1000 J/K
series.resistance_source: HT-003 series case: R_JC = 0.1 K/W as in the step case, R_CR = 0.05 K/W chosen for the test; SR, BR and DR are 1e12 K/W isolation paths
series.optical_source: HT-003 test configuration: exposed surfaces exchange nothing with the environment in this case
series.note: Hand calculation: the two time constants are 100 s and 25 s, so 3000 s is 30 slow time constants and the remaining transient is below 1e-11 K.

radiation.label: 辐射平衡
radiation.mass_source: HT-003 radiation case: C_R = 1000 J/K chosen for the test; other nodes 1000 J/K or 500 J/K
radiation.resistance_source: HT-003 radiation case: SR, CR, BR and DR are 1e12 K/W isolation paths, so the radiator has only its fixed input power and its own surface radiation; JC carries no flow because J and C stay equal
radiation.optical_source: HT-003 radiation case: both radiator faces absorptivity 0.6 and emissivity 0.8; only the front face sees the Sun, so the fixed input power is 0.6 x 1000 W/m2 x 1 m2 = 600 W; the solar array exchanges nothing with the environment
radiation.note: The radiator starts at 320 K and cools towards its radiation balance; the linearised time constant C_R / (4 eps sigma A T^3) is about 119 s, so 4000 s is about 34 time constants.
